en.longDescription:
Plausible is a lightweight, privacy-focused analytics alternative to Google Analytics.

Includes PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. Set BASE_URL via SERVICE_URL_PLAUSIBLE for accurate links and webhooks. Register your account on first launch.

de.longDescription:
